mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART ( CART_ID, CART_QUANTITY, CART_REG_DATE, MEMBER_ID, PROD_NUM, IS_GIFT, GIFT_TO_MEMBER_ID, GIFT_MESSAGE ) VALUES ( #{cartId}, #{cartQuantity}, #{cartRegDate}, #{memberId}, #{prodNum}, NVL(#{isGift}, 'N'), #{giftToMemberId}, #{giftMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT C.CART_ID, C.CART_QUANTITY, C.PROD_NUM, C.IS_GIFT, C.GIFT_TO_MEMBER_ID, C.GIFT_MESSAGE, P.PROD_IMAGE1, P.SELLER_ID, P.PROD_NAME, P.PROD_PRICE, NVL(P.PROD_DELIVERYFEE, 0) PROD_DELIVERYFEE FROM CART C JOIN PRODUCT P ON (C.PROD_NUM = P.PROD_NUM) WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT CART_ID, CART_QUANTITY, CART_REG_DATE, MEMBER_ID, PROD_NUM, IS_GIFT, GIFT_TO_MEMBER_ID, GIFT_MESSAGE FROM CART WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PROD_NUM = #{prodNum}
